746980101.text: Oh, look... Miko's over there. Paimon gets the feeling things are about to get stressful...

746980102.text: You remember the Mikawa Flower Festival, right? Sure, everything turned out for the best, but it was a real headache to get there...

746980103.text: And she made us sign ourselves away.

746980104.text: But not this time... Hehe, we're not the ones doing labor, so we definitely won't—

746980106.text: #Well, well... {NICKNAME}, Paimon. To think we'd run into each other all the way out here in Fontaine. So, what are you—

746980107.text: ...Whoa! M—Miko! Did you hear that just now?

746980108.text: No, I didn't hear a thing. But judging by your expression, I doubt it was anything... flattering?

746980109.text: No, no, it's not like that! We're really happy to see you, Miko. Hehehe... What brings you to Fontaine, anyway?

746980112.text: Why else would a poor, overworked Editor-in-Chief like me be here? I'm toiling away on Yae Publishing House business, of course.

746980113.text: I had just bought a box of new books and was planning to take them back for my editors to study...

746980114.text: When who should I see but an old friend of mine lingering at this fortune-telling booth for the longest time.

746980115.text: Back home, she rarely visits the shrine to draw fortune slips, so her sudden interest in fortune-telling was quite the surprise...

746980116.text: Still, while strolling around the city, I overheard people talking about an unusually accurate fortune-teller out here in the countryside.

746980117.text: So, I came to get a reading, if only to... satisfy my curiosity.

746980118.text: Huh? You're finished already? Why didn't you say so sooner!?

746980120.text: My, my, taking such an interest in my future, are we? Hehe, if you want to know, I might be persuaded to let you see. However, you'll have to pay a price.

746980121.text: Let me think... Ah! How about you sign on with Yae Publishing House? You can compile your adventures into a thrilling novel.

746980122.text: Following the latest naming trends, we could call it, "I Picked Up Emergency Food at the Start, and Now I'm Invincible." Oh, we're going to sell so many copies!

746980123.text: It would need to be a pretty thick book...

746980124.text: Who cares? As long as it's entertaining, you can make it as long as you want. I once published a light novel called "The Horizon Beyond the Paradox."

746980125.text: That book was as thick as a dictionary and spanned eight volumes. Then there were three companion guides and six spin-offs — stack them all up and they'd reach the ceiling.

746980126.text: If you manage to churn out that much, then I, Editor-in-Chief, will edit it all personally. What do you say?
